subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does ACP ownership want to request a concrete protocol-level reproduction for this alleged approval bypass, or close it because the described tokenization path does not exist in current OpenClaw?
rationale: The observable current-main code does not match the report, but the alleged impact crosses an approval security boundary and cannot safely be resolved from source mismatch alone without ACP SDK/runtime intent and evidence.

options.title: Request targeted reproduction
options.body: Ask for exact versions, token-limit configuration, payload, concurrent event sequence, and a redacted ACP protocol trace before selecting a fix boundary.

options.title: Close as unsupported
options.body: Close if ACP ownership confirms there is no tokenizer or independent chunk-processing path capable of advancing before `requestPermission` resolves.

options.title: Route private exploit details
options.body: If the reporter has a working approval bypass, move the concrete exploit and trace through the repository's private security-reporting process.
